description: Emit prompt text strings for LLM demos. Three v1 modes: literal per-key mapping, template+topics, or a fixed single prompt. Sibling of synthetic_image_generator / synthetic_audio_generator / synthetic_pdf_generator / synthetic_video_generator.

outputs.description: One str-valued asset. Partitioned when prompts:/topics: is used; unpartitioned when prompt: is used.

prompts.description: Mode A: {partition_key: prompt_text} mapping. Each key becomes a static partition; the mapped text is the partition's output. Mutually exclusive with `topics`+`template` and `prompt`.

topics.description: Mode B: list of topics. Each becomes a static partition. Requires `template`.

template.description: Mode B: template rendered per topic. `{topic}` and `{partition_key}` substituted with the topic value.

prompt.description: Mode C: unpartitioned single-string prompt. Mutually exclusive with the two partitioned modes.
